B.type: same IF plus thermal calibration only

C.type: same IF plus operating calibration only

calibration.context_representation: Macro axes separately; fine labels are parallel descriptive validation strata only. No joint B+C estimator or cross-axis fallback.
calibration.cutoff: q_context is the smallest observed raw calibration score with cumulative weight >= alpha=0.03 (weighted empirical inverse CDF, sorted score ascending, ties combined). Candidate flags raw_score < q_context. Retain raw scores and optionally report weighted ECDF as calibration-tail rank, not fault probability.
calibration.extremity_guard: On supported contexts, preserve every A-flagged window with raw_score < fitting-only training_score_p01, even if q_context would suppress it. This is a statistical-extremity sentinel from existing metadata, NOT a verified severity or fault cutoff. Never use test score percentiles.
calibration.fallback: For unknown/abstained, boundary-ambiguous/unresolved, missing/unapproved context, or insufficient calibration support: calibration ABSTAINS, use A prediction/offset unchanged; retain the window and explicit fallback reason. Never majority vote. A/B/C all score the same eligible windows.
calibration.score_direction: lower raw score is more unusual
calibration.weighting: Each qualified calibration capture has equal total weight 1/G; each of its n retained context windows has weight 1/(G*n). No claim that retained windows are temporally independent.
calibration.window_selection: Within each calibration group/context, sort by row_start and greedily retain a window only if row_start exceeds previous retained row_end. No score-dependent thinning. Groups with fewer than three retained windows do not contribute to that context.

context_review_policy.required_before_execution: Collector submits genuine decisions/time and separately approves an execution protocol revision pinning response and context-overlay hashes before any fitting. Targeted review is not whole-corpus validation. Corrections remain an audit overlay; approved-v2 unchanged. Reject/Uncertain/missing review support never becomes confirmed context or normal mechanical truth.
context_review_policy.unresolved_regions: Windows touching rejected/uncertain review regions or unresolved 001 discrepancies must abstain from contextual calibration and fall back to A. No retrospective label changes based on IF flags.

future_artifact_policy: All fitted IF/scaler/calibration artifacts disposable research-only; seal fit/calibration inventories, features, hashes, cutoffs/support/fallback metadata before outer-test inference. No production routes/models/threshold writes.
metrics_preregistered: Capture-level raw score and calibrated-tail-rank quantiles (p01,p05,p25,p50,p75,p95,p99); raw score invariant across arms; known/unknown/ambiguous/fallback strata separate.
Per-capture flagged-window frequency and A-to-B/A-to-C paired differences; equal-capture primary, duration weighted secondary, pooled windows descriptive only.
Consecutive flagged-window runs using existing H2 helper and original timestamps; runs/full capture-hour, flagged union-time, run duration distribution. No summing overlap durations.

Event changes: bipartite matching by any common flagged window ID; count unchanged-window-set runs, changed one-to-one components, splits, merges, disappearing and newly appearing components. Retain exact window IDs; no tuned IoU threshold.

Unsupported coverage by context/capture/fold: candidate-applied and every fallback-reason denominator in windows and union time; calibration groups and retained nonoverlapping counts; no unsupported zero-risk interpretation.

Sensitivity: fixed predictions with each and each pair of captures removed from aggregation; explicitly 006/015/023/014. Also exclude <10-window captures and mask the six discrepant 001 windows. No threshold refit selected by these results.

Post-primary fitting sensitivity: repeat each fixed fold omitting 006,015,023 or014 only when it was a fitting or calibration member; never move its role or replace it. Reseal A/B/C shared artifacts; recheck support and use fallback. All deletions specified, not chosen by test outcomes; no tuning from sensitivity.

Capture bootstrap 10000 draws seed42 of fixed paired capture summaries, descriptive percentile95 interval; none with <3 supported groups. Overlapping windows and shared fold training remain dependent; no independent-window tests or diagnostic accuracy claims.

CPU wall latency p50/p95 over 10 fixed-order inference repeats after warm-up, peak RSS, calibration runtime and artifact bytes; report hardware/versions, IF inference separate from lookup overhead. No deployment-limit change.

Masking audit: enumerate every baseline-flagged window/event removed, raw score, fitting-only p01 extremity status and measured evidence refs. Require zero lost sentinel windows. Preserve raw evidence and any independently supplied high-severity mechanical evidence; absent verified physical severity truth, masking risk remains unresolved. No RCA/Contextual Battery change.

partition_policy.aliases_and_derivatives: Not inputs; any future alias/split/augmentation must inherit parent group and cannot cross partitions. Unresolved/synthetic data excluded.
partition_policy.assignment: Sort original session IDs; random.Random(42).shuffle once. For outer test index i, next five cyclic groups calibrate; remaining twelve fit. Each group tests once, calibrates five times and fits twelve times. No support/outcome-driven reassignment.
partition_policy.test_access: Use test telemetry only for fixed feature extraction/inference after fit and calibration hashes sealed. No fitting, support optimization, cutoff choice or hyperparameter selection from outer-test outcomes. Prior H10 exposure remains disclosed.

preprocessing: Unchanged production features; default RobustScaler and IF fitted only on fitting groups. Training captures unlabeled, not confirmed healthy. No balancing or model hyperparameter search.
shared_model_invariance: One scaler/IF fit per fold, shared byte-identically across A/B/C. Raw score and test-window identity must match across arms. Do not reuse H10.1 fitted models: they fitted 17 groups, including the new calibration groups.
study_type: EXPLORATORY; prior selection and H10.1 outcomes known, not confirmatory

success_and_stop_rules.accuracy: No fault sensitivity, true false-positive rate, normal-condition verification, or cross-motorcycle generalization claim without independent physical evidence.
success_and_stop_rules.engineering: Abort on hash/group leakage, raw-score/window/model mismatch, lost baseline fallback, sentinel loss, invalid context mapping, or provenance mismatch.
success_and_stop_rules.selection: Reduced alert counts alone cannot pass a candidate. Report effect heterogeneity, support, overhead and masking without tuning. Any further research decision requires explicit human assessment; no automatic model/cutoff promotion.
